subject: [PATCH 2/2] cgroup/cpuset: use mems_allowed_seq when checking a policy nodemask

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the Linux kernel's cgroup/cpuset code where a task's mempolicy could be rebound and its mems_allowed changed separately, causing a spurious numa placement miss when checking if a nodemask is valid. The fix involves retrying the intersection of the nodemask with the current task's mems_allowed until mems_allowed_seq is stable. This ensures that the check always sees the updated values, preventing a dropped nodemask and misallocated memory.
